title: Paid off $10k of student loans in 2 years on a modest income
body: I'm 24 and just finished paying off my own student loan debt. I had to take out about $25k for undergrad, but my parents helped with the interest while I was in school. Once I graduated, I set up an automatic transfer of $500 per month from my checking account to my loan servicer, which ended up being around 7-8% of my after-tax income. title: My secret to perfectly cooked rice
body: Man, I spent way too much time messing up rice. I finally figured out the right ratio and the soaking technique. For white rice, I soak it in water for about twenty minutes before adding the water to the pot. Then, I use exactly two cups of water for every one cup of uncooked rice. It really makes a huge difference in texture and flavor. Try it next time, it saves a ton of frustration.

title: No-till worked for my corn this year
body: Been doing some no-till for a while now and I finally saw some real results this season. I was skeptical at first, thinking it was just more work, but cutting down on tillage really changed things for me. The soil stayed much more consistent and the weeds weren't as of a problem. It takes some adjustment at the start, especially getting used to the planter setup, but I'm seeing better water retention and less fuel burned overall. Definitely worth the transition if you can manage the change.
